notes.title: Small patch for the Gallery
notes.notes:
Hi there,

We just released a small patch to fix a bug with Gallery persistence data across different save profiles (previously, Gallery data was always being stored in the Default profile).

We’re still hard at work investigating the crashes and the achievements not unlocking on macOS. We’ll have more updates soon!

Cheers!

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets Release Imminent!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42003585/a2cce826ef3c4eb5e1b8b42abde21d19a12d5622.jpg

Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that, after a few challenging months of hard work and adjustments, Steam Support has officially approved Shale Hill Secrets for sale!

Right now, our entire team is putting in every effort to finalize and polish the last details so we can launch the game as soon as possible. While we don’t have an exact release date to share just yet, we’re aiming to release within the next couple of weeks — which means the game will definitely be out this month!

Our next post will share the official release date, so stay tuned!

Thank you all so much for your patience and support.
The Love-Joint Team

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update | 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, how's it going?

Just dropping in to say hi and share an update on the game - we're in those final adjustment stages for our Steam release. Being our first time launching here, we've hit a few more hurdles than expected with the process as a whole...

Also, since our game has some, let's say, "spicier" content, we're having to be extra careful with everything. The good news is that development finished up several weeks ago, and we're really close to seeing it pop up in the store! 

All the best and thank you for your patience and support!

Love-Joint team

notes.title: Shale Hill Secrets development update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, how's it going?

We wanted to say hello and let you know we haven't forgotten about Steam! We're still working and adjusting some things to launch the game here. Unfortunately, we’re having some headaches that every game developer faces along the way…

To be more specific, some parts of the game's original code need updating and reworking for this platform, but it's nothing too serious and we're already finishing up with all of that. We're also taking the opportunity to touch up the animations, remastering all of them, increasing the videos resolution, improving the loops, and, especially, tweaking the sound effects.

Anyway, we're a very small team and some tasks end up taking more time than we expected, but the game is 95% ready for Steam and very soon we'll have a launch date.
Stay tuned and thanks for your interest!
